citation: Maier L., Jansen D., Wüllhorst F., Kremer M., Kümpel A., Blacha T., Müller D. (2023). AixLib: an open-source Modelica library for compound building energy systems from component to district level with automated quality management. Journal of Building Performance Simulation 17, 196-219. doi:10.1080/19401493.2023.2250521
description: AixLib is a Modelica model library for building performance simulation, containing models of HVAC systems and of buildings at high and reduced order, from component to district level. It is developed at RWTH Aachen University's Institute for Energy Efficient Buildings and Indoor Climate (E.ON Energy Research Center) and builds on the Modelica IBPSA Library core, with automated quality management of its models. Coverage is generic and not tied to a country, although its archetype workflow with TEASER is rooted in German building typologies. It is distributed as Modelica source on GitHub, cloned with submodules; release 3.0.1 was tagged in June 2026, and a readiness badge is published for OpenModelica. Licence: 3-clause BSD, free of charge. Caveat: it requires a Modelica simulation environment; reduced-order building models trade detail for speed and should be checked against the intended use. Simulation uses are HVAC and building system sizing (capacity planning) and control and design optimisation, including district-scale studies. Related records: Modelica IBPSA Library (its core), TEASER (generates AixLib building models), Modelica Buildings Library, IDEAS and BuildingSystems (sister libraries).
